t.about.meta.title: About AIVIS.ONE: the company, the name, the founder
t.about.meta.desc: AIVIS.ONE is a company of one founder who works with AI agents. It builds SANKORD and offers free courses. The name, the founder, the company details.
t.about.lead: AIVIS.ONE is a company for people who already see what they want to build. It is run by one founder who works with AI agents, and it has no staff. Today it builds SANKORD, a system of AI agents that works inside the walls of the business it serves, and it runs four free courses on working with AI.
t.about.name.title: Why the name
t.about.name.p1: AIVIS.ONE reads as AI + VIS + ONE. VIS is vision: the sight of a visionary who works with AI. The dot in the name stands in for the i, so it also reads as i-Vision.
t.about.name.p2: There is a little Latin behind it too: avis, a bird; vis, force; and videre, to see, and the Romans joined bird, sight and prediction in the auspicium.
t.about.founder.title: The founder
t.about.founder.p1: My name is Artem Baliakno, and I am the founder of AIVIS.ONE. Over the years I have experimented a great deal and packaged hundreds of projects. Since 2023 I have spent more than 10,000 hours working hands-on with language models. Neural networks freed my imagination and my design and let one person develop and promote projects tens of times faster. That is why I created AIVIS.ONE.
t.about.founder.p2: I am a systems architect with more than twenty years in the technology business. AIVIS.ONE is where I put to work everything those years and hours taught me.
t.about.how.title: How the company works
t.about.how.p1: AIVIS.ONE has no employees, and I say so on purpose. I own the company in full. I work with AI agents, which are the company’s labour force, not a metaphor and not a marketing line. They handle sales, content, support, development and research, while I set the goals.
t.about.how.p2: For technical, legal and sales questions I consult specialists, who advise me and are not employees.
t.about.how.p3: Both sides, honestly: where a machine can check the result, one person with AI agents covers ground that used to take a team. Where someone has to decide what is worth building at all, the pace is the pace of one person. I tell you both halves together, because the first without the second would be a boast.
t.about.sankord.title: Why I am building SANKORD
t.about.sankord.name: SANKORD
t.about.sankord.promise: The day-to-day leaves your head. Nothing irreversible happens without your yes.
t.about.sankord.category: AI agents inside your walls. Under your watch.
t.about.sankord.p1: SANKORD is a system of AI agents that runs the day-to-day work of a business inside its own walls, on its own servers or in its own cloud account, while the decisions stay with the owner. One command stops the whole system, and every step is written down.
t.about.sankord.p2: I am building SANKORD out of what I worked through myself: neural networks, projects, startups. A way of running a business with AI agents grew out of that. SANKORD is that same way, turned into a product.
t.about.sankord.who.label: Who it is for
t.about.sankord.who: The one who makes the decisions in their business, at any scale, when the work stopped fitting in one head or one chain of approvals and the data cannot go to an external API.
t.about.sankord.p3: The name joins two words, sanction and accord. The working version can be installed from January 2027, and everything in detail is on [[sankord.com|https://sankord.com]].
t.about.courses.title: Take my experience and put it to work at once
t.about.courses.p1: The courses hand over what my own hours with language models taught me, so that your hours go into your product and not into building tools. There are four courses, and all four are free.
t.about.courses.p2: “Tasks. Frame and Run” is about how to set a task for a neural network and check what comes back. “Skills. Build and Use” is about why skills work and how to build and use them. “Agents. Set Up and Lead” is about what AI agents are and how to work with them. “Projects. Launch and Grow” is about how to launch a project and grow it, built on the EXSPECS protocol.
t.about.courses.p3: SANKORD grew out of the same work these courses are built from. Each course leads to a useful tool for your business, your work with neural networks, your project or your AI agents.

t.faq.g3.title: Courses
t.faq.g3.a1: The courses hand over what more than 10,000 hours with language models taught the founder. They are free so that this experience works for you at once, and your hours go into your product, not into building tools.
t.faq.g3.q2: Which course should I start with?
t.faq.g3.a2: The first, “Tasks. Frame and Run”. The others follow in order: “Skills. Build and Use”, “Agents. Set Up and Lead” and “Projects. Launch and Grow”. The path runs from managing AI, to working with it systematically, to working with agents and launching projects.
t.faq.g3.a3: EXSPECS is a protocol for developing projects that keeps the spec in charge. The fourth course, “Projects. Launch and Grow”, is built on it. The protocol is part of the free courses.
t.faq.g3.q4: What do I get from a course?
t.faq.g3.a4: Knowledge you put to work at once, and a useful tool. Each course leads to a tool for your business, your work with neural networks, your project or your AI agents.
t.faq.g3.q5: May I share the course materials?
t.faq.g3.a5: Yes. The courses are published under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0: you may copy and share the material unmodified, for non-commercial purposes and with credit. You may use the tools from the courses in your own work, including inside your company. Selling them, sharing an adapted version, or any other commercial use needs written permission; the details are on the [[licence page|~/about/licence/]].
